background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: painted panoramic background for a 2D side-scrolling Halloween level, "5-1: The Ashen Graveyard".
Image 1 is the visual style and environmental continuity reference: the game has just passed through that burned forest. Create a NEW 3072x1024 wide panorama, fully opaque, same detailed painted-and-inked storybook game style. Environment only, no heroes, no enemies, no UI.
A sparse forest AFTER the fire has died: blackened trunks without foliage, low gray ash hills and scattered ruined stone walls. In the distance rows of crooked old gravestones become visible through layered lavender fog. Warm amber embers on the far LEFT fade into a cold violet-blue Halloween night toward the RIGHT. A luminous pale moon above the cemetery, purple clouds, tiny bats far in the sky, warm pumpkin lanterns much farther away, and the tiny silhouette of an old village with several warmly lit windows on the far RIGHT horizon. The landscape feels like a sinister fairytale emerging from someone's imagination. Preserve readable broad shapes, beautiful depth, muted warm copper and deep violet with small teal glows. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT modern pixel art. No puppets or strings, no giant clown balloons, no active forest blaze. Do not imitate a specific canon scene. This is a side-view layered distant landscape, not a top-down map or a centered poster. Leave the lower quarter mostly dark hills and soft fog so foreground gameplay can read cleanly.

zombie:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 12-frame character sprite atlas for a side-scrolling anime-cartoon game, 4 columns x 3 rows.
Image 1 is the existing normal clown and the painted sprite style. Create an ORIGINAL Halloween dream-creature derived from that circus identity: a short plump cartoon zombie clown, pale mint-green face, little orange-red nose, messy orange curls, patched dull plum-and-orange jumpsuit, a drooping orange pointed party cap, white oversized gloves, chunky curled dark-purple boots. Expressive large eyes and playful crooked toothy grin. Classic vintage 1930s cartoon charm blended with the game's painted anime-cartoon finish. Spooky, theatrical, endearing and mischievous, NOT gruesome or bleak. No blood, rot, bones sticking out, gore, puppet strings or wooden doll joints.
ALL twelve figures face LEFT, identical head, costume, body size and limb identity. Full body inside every equal cell, generous gutters, true transparency. Grounded soles same baseline, body gently bobs.
Frames 1-8: one FULL natural shambling WALK cycle, eight distinct cels. 1 near leg forward / far leg back contact; 2 weight down on near leg; 3 far leg passes raised under hip; 4 far leg reaches forward while near leg trails; 5 far leg forward / near leg back contact; 6 weight down on far leg; 7 near leg passes raised; 8 near leg reaches forward for return to frame 1. Keep the near leg in FRONT and the far leg BEHIND consistently, never exchange legs, never repeat the first half for the second half. Small arms swung awkwardly forward like a comic zombie, clear flexed knees and lifted feet, no skating.
Frame 9: anticipation, leans back with both hands pulled to chest, startled eyes.
Frame 10: short playful forward lunge, both gloves reach to the left, feet still distinct.
Frame 11: hurt recoil, eyes squeezed, hands up.
Frame 12: defeat, clown dissolving into a small curling lavender smoke puff, silly surprised face disappearing, no corpse.
Do not include labels, floor lines, backgrounds, halos, rectangles, extra characters. No stretchy necks or sideways turns.
